sources.title: Indeks Standar Pencemar Udara sebagai informasi mutu udara ambien di Indonesia
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Official explanation distinguishes dimensionless site-specific ISPU from concentrations and lists PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, CO, O3 and HC. PM2.5 results are published hourly; other parameters at least at 09:00 and 15:00. Existing local primary-law excerpt was also read narrowly: Permen LHK 14/2020 Article 6 uses continuous 24-hour monitoring, and Article 7 requires completeness checks and removal of abnormal observations. Those requirements do not certify completeness or calibration of these six live site readings.
excerpts: ISPU merupakan angka tanpa satuan, digunakan untuk menggambarkan kondisi mutu udara ambien di lokasi tertentu
Hasil perhitungan ISPU parameter PM2.5 disampaikan kepada publik tiap jam selama 24 jam.
sources.retrievalMethod: Native reader on current official explanatory page; targeted jq selection of legal duration and quality-control lines in prior air-exposure audit. Current BPK canonical regulation record confirms the rule remains in force; direct PDF retrieval returned 403.

sources.title: Evaluasi Polusi Udara PM2.5 dan PM10 di Kota Bandung serta Kaitannya dengan Infeksi Saluran Pernafasan Akut
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Primary open-access research article, DOI 10.14710/jkli.23.2.128-136, reports three roadside sites in Kota Bandung: Monumen 0 km, Alun-alun and Terminal Dago. Methods specify selected wet-season days in January–May 2023, 08:00–16:00, an HT-9600 particle counter, and seven weekday summaries. Exact calendar dates and day-level valid counts are not supplied. Narrative repeats the Monumen PM2.5 sample mean inconsistently. It compares daytime samples to daily standards without establishing a full 24-hour record. Consequently, neither regulatory exceedance claims nor a validated annual panel are adopted. PDF states CC BY-SA 4.0 and online availability 29 January 2024; regular issue is June 2024. Only metadata and short methodological excerpts are retained, not numerical rows or the original article.
excerpts: Pengambilan data dilakukan beberapa hari pada bulan-bulan basah, yaitu pada Januari hingga Mei 2023.
Waktu pengukuran dilaksanakan mulai pukul 08.00 hingga pukul 16.00.
This open-access article is distributed under the terms and conditions of the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License.
sources.retrievalMethod: Native PDF text extraction; methods printed page 130, site discussions pages 132–133, rights notice page 136. Landing-page publication metadata also inspected.

sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Current canonical publication metadata confirms release 29 November 2024 and revision 1 December 2024. Targeted prior primary-text receipt identifies Table 2.1.23, printed pages 97–98 / PDF pages 125–126, with 2023 SPM summaries for Bandung, Cibeureum and Dramaga. Technical notes specify gravimetry and 24-hour samples every six days. SPM/TSP is not PM10 or PM2.5. No station-to-municipality crosswalk or station-specific valid sample count is established by this table. No numerical observations are promoted. The current canonical page was re-fetched; PDF table evidence here was re-read from the previous locally preserved extraction, not newly downloaded.
excerpts: adalah setiap enam hari sekali selama 24 Jam
sources.retrievalMethod: Current native reader on canonical publication page plus narrow jq line selection from prior primary PDF extraction in data/raw/environment-audit-2023/air-exposure.json. No opaque download URLs, full PDF or page copies retained.

sources.publisher: Atmospheric Composition Analysis Group, Washington University in St. Louis
sources.title: SatPM2.5 V6.GL.02.04 methods, data availability and licence
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Current primary methods page confirms annual/monthly 1998–2023 V6.GL.02.04 grids, satellite aerosol optical depth plus GEOS-Chem and ground-monitor calibration through a residual convolutional neural network, and CC BY 4.0. Published processed summaries include countries and selected non-Indonesian subnational units, not a verified CIVX 27-region table. Provider warns that 0.01-degree spacing does not fully resolve local PM2.5 gradients. No raster extraction, centroid assignment, approximate-polygon averaging or population-weighting was performed.
excerpts: Note that these estimates are primarily intended to aid in large-scale studies.
Annual and coarse-resolution averages correspond to a simple mean of within-grid values.
SatPM2.5 data V6.GL.02.04 are licensed under CC BY 4.0
sources.retrievalMethod: Native reader on current provider method and licence page. Linked grid metadata from prior audit used only as a locator; no gridded numeric data stored.

candidates.missingness: Six verified site values associate with five of 27 target regions; two sites are in Kabupaten Bogor. safeStatements: The official publication contains 2023 SPM summaries for three named Jawa Barat monitoring stations.
unsafeStatements: SPM is PM10 or PM2.5.
The three station labels establish representative municipal annual pollution coverage.
candidates.temporalWarning: 2023 sampled station summaries published in November 2024, not contemporary 2023 release data.

candidates.title: ACAG SatPM2.5 V6.GL.02.04 annual 2023 grid as a proposed district exposure source
candidates.publisher: Atmospheric Composition Analysis Group, Washington University in St. Louis
candidates.referencePeriod: 2023 annual grid available within retrospective 1998–2023 series
candidates.geographicLevel: model grid; no validated CIVX administrative panel
candidates.definition: Modelled ground-level fine particulate mass concentration from satellite aerosol optical depth, atmospheric simulation and monitor calibration; not a direct district observation.
candidates.measurementMethod: V6.GL.02.04 combines multi-satellite AOD, GEOS-Chem and residual-CNN ground-monitor calibration. Administrative area means or population-weighted exposure would need explicitly validated boundaries, land/valid-cell coverage, weights and a reproducible estimand-specific overlay.
candidates.missingness: No grid values extracted and no region observations verified. Grid availability is not 27-region coverage. No certified 2023 administrative geometry, valid-cell intersection or population weight layer applied.
candidates.licenseOrUsageNotes: Provider explicitly licenses V6.GL.02.04 under CC BY 4.0. Rights are not the blocker. Provider methods and version must be attributed; no gridded numeric data copied in this audit.

comparability.reason: No validated administrative geography or area-versus-population exposure estimand and aggregation has been applied. Grid spacing is not effective local accuracy.

knownBiases: Satellite retrieval, model and monitor-calibration uncertainty.
Coarser underlying inputs limit local gradients despite fine grid spacing.
Retrospective calibration updates can revise the entire historical series.
limitations: No extraction using uncertified approximate 2020 polygons.
No centroid sampling, country-value copying, imputation or forced normalization.
No Indonesian kabupaten/kota panel identified in the provider's processed summary listings.
No claims that area means equal population-weighted exposure.
candidates.recommendedUse: Do not ingest until geography, estimand and reproducible spatial coverage are validated; retain source/method/licence findings only.
candidates.decisionReason: Accessible licensed scientific grid, but a usable CIVX district dataset is not supplied or validated. No silent geographic extraction is justified.
safeStatements: A licensed 2023 modelled PM2.5 grid exists; this audit has not produced verified CIVX regional estimates.
unsafeStatements: The grid already provides 27 verified administrative observations.
An approximate polygon mean is measured regional population exposure.
Fine grid spacing guarantees block-scale accuracy.
candidates.temporalWarning: 2023 model reference period is retrospective and does not imply publication or availability in 2023; version changes affect comparability.
